title: antidesma laciniatum subsp. membranaceum
intro: Antidesma laciniatum subsp. membranaceum, commonly known as the cut-leaf velvet tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant is rich in medicinal properties and has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Antidesma laciniatum subsp. membranaceum include wound healing, reducing fever, and treating gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
